Here is the complete navigation findings from all three files.

---

## Navigation Definition — `app/routes/app.tsx`

### Component Used
The navigation is rendered using the `<s-app-nav>` web component (a Shopify App Bridge v4 custom element), with individual items as `<s-link>` elements. This is NOT a Polaris `NavMenu` or `NavigationMenu` — it is the App Bridge native nav web component that renders as the embedded app's sidebar in the Shopify admin.

### Nav Items — Exact Order

| Position | Label | href |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Dashboard | `/app` |
| 2 | Zip Codes | `/app/zip-codes` |
| 3 | Delivery Rules | `/app/delivery-rules` |
| 4 | Waitlist | `/app/waitlist` |
| 5 | Widget Customization | `/app/widget` |
| 6 | Help & Support | `/app/help` |
| 7 | Settings | `/app/settings` |

The JSX is at lines 65-73 of `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.tsx`:

```tsx
<s-app-nav>
  <s-link href="/app">Dashboard</s-link>
  <s-link href="/app/zip-codes">Zip Codes</s-link>
  <s-link href="/app/delivery-rules">Delivery Rules</s-link>
  <s-link href="/app/waitlist">Waitlist</s-link>
  <s-link href="/app/widget">Widget Customization</s-link>
  <s-link href="/app/help">Help & Support</s-link>
  <s-link href="/app/settings">Settings</s-link>
</s-app-nav>
```

---

## `app/root.tsx` — No Navigation

`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/root.tsx` is a bare HTML shell (lines 1-24). It contains only `<html>`, `<head>`, `<body>`, `<Outlet />`, `<ScrollRestoration />`, and `<Scripts />`. No navigation defined here.

---

## `app/routes/app._index.tsx` — No Navigation

`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app._index.tsx` is the Dashboard page component. It contains no navigation definition. It does reference several routes via `useNavigate()` calls (for buttons and banners), but these are imperative navigations, not nav menu definitions.

---

## Summary

All navigation is defined in exactly one place: `app/routes/app.tsx`, inside the `<s-app-nav>` web component. There are 7 items in this order: Dashboard, Zip Codes, Delivery Rules, Waitlist, Widget Customization, Help & Support, Settings. Note that `/app/pricing` does not appear in the nav (it is only reachable from the dashboard upgrade banner and settings buttons).
